_comment: Run template for lbnl-boiler: the hot-water loop differential-pressure reset. The boiler status points are enables, not firing (see the catalog's data issues), so rules needing boiler_status decline here. This rule detects none of the 16 faults. Boiler fouling shows as gas input per unit of heat (boiler 1's gas +57% at 065): since 0.92 the gas input maps to gas_input_rate and the boiler drift family (boiler_efficiency_drift, a baseline-vs-current period rule run with drift.families) reads it. There is still no supply-temperature setpoint to compare the loop supply with.
